cues.text: Voltage rises quickly, then approaches the supply more slowly.
Keep R, C and the supply fixed. Watch the same model drive the graph.
Predict: after one RC, is the capacitor fully charged?
No. After one RC, it reaches about 63.2% of the supply.
The curve approaches 10 V; it does not jump there instantly.
